method.method_draft: First describe the figure: a J-K flip-flop has J connected to logic 1 and K connected to logic 0. Then use the characteristic equation for a J-K flip-flop, Q_next = J·not(Q) + not(K)·Q. Substitute J=1 and K=0 to obtain Q_next = not(Q) + Q = 1. Therefore the circuit forces the flip-flop into the set state, i.e. set to 1.
